svg.title: ARA-290 (cibinetide): what has actually been tested
svg.desc: ARA-290 (cibinetide): what has actually been tested. Regulatory status: Not approved in the US or EU; FDA and EU orphan designations for sarcoidosis uses only. Verdict: Not approved. Design and animal studies: Built from part of EPO to protect tissue without raising red cells; nerve-pain relief in rats. Verdict: Promising in animals. Sarcoidosis nerve pain (2012-2013): Two small placebo-controlled trials (22 and 38 people, 4 weeks): symptom scores improved. Verdict: Early, small. Sarcoidosis phase 2b (2017): 64 people: nerve-fiber goal met in 1 of 3 dose groups; pain improved on placebo too. Verdict: Mixed. Diabetes neuropathy (2015): 49 people, 4 weeks: one symptom questionnaire improved; corneal nerves in a subgroup. Verdict: Early, small. Mood and diabetic eye swelling: No mood effect in 36 healthy adults (2015); no vision benefit in 9 people (2020). Verdict: No benefit shown. Long-term use in people: No published trial treated anyone for longer than 12 weeks; none is active today. Verdict: Not tested. Safety: Short trials: no clear safety signal, but serious events seen only on drug in two trials. Verdict: Unknown long-term.
